meta.note: Synthetic test data. Not the CES dataset. S1 cases carry name_score_rules (the rule-based similarity before any LLM). S1-hold-name cases are pinned to a 75-90 rule score; the live LLM gray-zone step (70-92) can still raise some to Apply. S1-apply-a cases with a rule score of 90 or below only reach Apply through the LLM step, so they separate the rules-only and live-LLM arms of an ablation.
